title.en: Two Mars missions retain contact while their backup margins narrow
title.zh: 两项火星任务仍有联系，备用余量却在收窄

summary.en: NASA’s November 19 update describes separate radio and reaction-wheel problems affecting Perseverance and Odyssey. Contact and protective systems survive while science pauses; restart goals and fuel estimates remain uncertain.
summary.zh: NASA于11月19日说明毅力号与奥德赛号各自的无线电、反作用轮问题。通信与保护系统仍在发挥作用，科学工作暂停，复工目标及燃料估计仍有不确定性。
